SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS dist_keys, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS mn, max(etl_loaded_at) AS mx, sum(closing_value) AS val
FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT category, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT sku) AS skus, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur FROM dim_product WHERE category ILIKE '%paint%' OR category ILIKE '%decor%' GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT fs.week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (s.store_id, p.sku)) AS dist_sku_store,
  count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_phys,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='Paint & Decorating' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paint_rows,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.category='Paint & Decorating' THEN (s.store_id, p.sku) END) AS paint_dist,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='Paint & Decorating' THEN fs.closing_value END) AS paint_val,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='Paint & Decorating' THEN fs.closing_units END) AS paint_units,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='Paint & Decorating' THEN fs.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost END) AS paint_units_x_cost,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='Paint & Decorating' AND fs.closing_units<0 THEN 1 END) AS neg
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w1 AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, p.sku, p.category, p.delisted_on, p.listed_from, p.is_current, fs.closing_units, fs.closing_value, fs.receipts_units, fs.adjustment_units
 FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
 WHERE fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-07-05'),
w2 AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, p.sku FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
 WHERE fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-07-12')
SELECT w1.* FROM w1 LEFT JOIN w2 USING (store_id, sku) WHERE w2.sku IS NULL AND w1.category='Paint & Decorating' ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 40

SELECT fs.week_ending_date,
  sum(CASE WHEN cp.category='Paint & Decorating' THEN fs.closing_value END) AS as_is_val,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='Paint & Decorating' THEN fs.closing_value END) AS as_was_val,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cp.category='Paint & Decorating' THEN s.store_id END) AS as_is_stores,
  min(CASE WHEN cp.category='Paint & Decorating' THEN fs.closing_value END) AS minv,
  max(CASE WHEN cp.category='Paint & Decorating' THEN fs.closing_value END) AS maxv
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id<900 AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, count(*) AS wk, round(avg(fs.closing_value),0) AS v FROM (
 SELECT fs.store_key, fs.week_ending_date, sum(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
 WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND p.category='Paint & Decorating' GROUP BY 1,2) fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY v
LIMIT 8

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT fs.week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
    AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category, ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value_at_cost_eur FROM weekly
